state.paragraph: Later on September 11, 2013, the Special Committee held a telephonic meeting to review the revised indications of interest submitted by Party A, Party B, Party C and CSC/Pamplona. By invitation of the Special Committee, Mr. Shea and Mr. Emma, as well as representatives from BofA Merrill Lynch and Goodwin Procter, were present for all or portions of the meeting. BofA Merrill Lynch reviewed with the Special Committee the current status of the revised indications of interest. The Special Committee also reviewed and discussed the Projections, including the risks and opportunities relating to Mac-Gray's ability to execute its strategic plan as an independent, stand-alone company. The Special Committee also considered the Projections in light of the revised indications of interest. BofA Merrill Lynch then indicated that, based on conversations with Party A, Party B, Party C and CSC/Pamplona, it was unlikely that any of these parties would move forward in the process without the express support of Mr. MacDonald. ledger_rows.Note: Revised IOI, up from $18.50 (#18). Pamplona commits 100% of the capital. Requests 2-week exclusivity. Heavy: customer data still withheld and further in-depth diligence expected.
Revised IOI, up from $17.00-$18.00 (#21). Financing from affiliated-fund equity plus third-party debt; no firm financing commitment (Heavy).
Revised IOI, one day late; same range as its 06/21 proposal (#7). To be financed by existing credit facilities or affiliated equity; no firm financing commitment (Heavy).
Revised oral IOI to BofA, one day late; revises #24 ($16.00-$16.50). No firm financing commitment (Heavy).

Rollover refused by holder: CEO and major holder says he won't roll over shares. BofA reports bidders unlikely to proceed without his support; committee has him fully briefed (09/12). He backs the process, wants higher value.
BofA calls all four the same day asking for final IOIs by 09/18/2013. Short exclusivity offered to one bidder depending on price and deal certainty.

Final-round proposal, up from $19.50 (#28); Formal as a response to the final solicitation. Pamplona commits 100% of the capital; only confirmatory diligence followed (Light). Requests 2-week exclusivity.
By phone to BofA: confirms #31 as its best and final offer, answering the final solicitation. The 09/10 bid had no firm financing commitment and none is reported since (Heavy).

Party B values its bid at $21.50: $19.00 cash plus options for 10% of new equity, which it values at $2.50 and which vest on a five-year target. Debt-and-equity financing, no commitment reported (Heavy).
Did not submit or reaffirm its $16.00-$17.00 IOI (#32) and gave no reason. Reported on 09/19; not seen again.
Due date for final IOIs, reached. On 09/19 the committee acted on the bids in hand (enforced).

bid.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a bidder submits, revises, confirms or reaffirms a priced proposal, indication of interest or offer for the company. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
